findings.text: The REQ-7/REQ-9 web test checks only that the elements exist (getBy...toBeTruthy). It cannot catch changed content or layout, which S-3 AC4 requires.

rubric_items.reason: Tests cover every changed path (CO-1 to CO-5, EP-1 to EP-3): GET, POST and PATCH carry visitSummary, and the web block is tested. The earlier gaps for S-2 AC2 at the API, S-1 AC4 and S-3 AC1/AC2 are now tested. Only S-1 AC2 has no test of its own.

The API tests use exact toEqual and status checks, and the web order tests compare the row codes. The REQ-7/REQ-9 web test still only checks that elements exist (toBeTruthy), which is weak for 'same content and layout'.

Tests cover 404 on GET and PATCH and 400 with field errors on POST. They also cover a past Scheduled appointment that was never closed, the latest Cancelled appointment, a second patient, all time, zero, only Scheduled and Cancelled, an empty list, and no medical history.
Vitest+Supertest on its own throwaway DB with a controllable clock and skipIf(!pgAvailable()); Vitest+jsdom+Testing Library on web. All test names start with HMS-5 REQ-n.
The artifact states no test counts or coverage and leaves results to the verifier. checks.json shows test passed and coverage skipped (exit 78), which matches C5.
